summary: Tested 6 new feature enhancements (origem_anexo, Outros tipo caso, telefone NE, clickable NE dashboard cards, NotificationBell NE routing, NE edit password dialog) + regressions. Backend: 7/7 pytest pass. Frontend: all 6 features verified working. Identified one pre-existing (not new) backend bug in case-number generation using count_documents+1 which causes 500 duplicate-key errors if cases deleted.

minor.issue: Case number uses count_documents()+1 and collides with existing numero (unique index) when cases have been deleted or inserted out-of-sequence. Causes 500 DuplicateKeyError. Pre-existing bug, not introduced by this iteration. Recommend: use max(numero)+1 or atomic counter collection.

features_verified.F1_origem_anexo: PASS - Field present in process dialog (data-testid=process-origem-anexo) and status change dialog (data-testid=status-origem-anexo). Displayed on case detail (line 484). Backend persists via /cases/{id}/process and /cases/{id}/status. Verified via pytest GET after PUT.
features_verified.F2_outros_tipo_caso: PASS - 'Outros' option visible in Tipo de Caso Select dropdown in CaseForm.
features_verified.F3_telefone_NE: PASS - Input with data-testid=ne-telefone present in NotifExternaForm at /notificacoes-externas/nova. Backend accepts, persists & returns telefone field. Displayed in NotifExternaDetail.
features_verified.F4_dashboard_NE_cards: PASS - 3 NE cards visible (Notificações Externas, NE - Aguarde, NE - Concluídas). All 3 clickable, NE-Aguarde href=/notificacoes-externas?status=aguarde confirmed. Backend dashboard/stats returns ne_aguarde & ne_concluida.
features_verified.F5_notificationBell_NE_routing: PASS - NE admin notification in bell links to /notificacoes-externas/:id (confirmed href in popover).
features_verified.F6_NE_edit_password_dialog: PASS - Clicking Atualizar on NE edit shows password dialog (input[type=password] visible).

regressions_verified.dashboard_case_cards: PASS - Total, Processados, Pendentes, Em Processo, Arquivados, Anulados all rendered on dashboard
regressions_verified.NE_list_status_filter: PASS - Status filter dropdown present (3 comboboxes: search hidden + qualidade + status). Backend API /notificacoes-externas?status=aguarde|apresentacao_concluida|all working.

action_items: (Pre-existing, optional) Fix /api/cases POST case-number generation to avoid dup-key on numero index. Use max(numero)+1 or a counters collection instead of count_documents()+1.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 461-462: Case number generation via count_documents+1 is not safe against deletes/concurrency. Replace with max(numero)+1 aggregation or atomic counter doc.
server.py: _id.popped inconsistently - list_users/list_cases use projection {'_id':0} (good), but some endpoints rely on pop. Consistent projection approach recommended.

NE form: useParams matches /:id route, so an invalid /notificacoes-externas/novo URL (instead of /nova) triggers 404 + 'Erro ao carregar notificação' toast. Consider showing proper Not-Found or validating id format is a UUID before fetching.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test NE record during pytest; cleaned up. origem_anexo tests mutated an existing case and restored original status.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 new feature enhancements from iteration 3 are working end-to-end. Backend pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py (7 tests) + test_notificacoes_externas.py (iteration 2). One pre-existing non-blocking backend bug around case numero generation. Feature 6 password dialog tested on live DB by clicking Atualizar on existing NE record.
